name: INFLATABLE SWIMMING POOL  115 CM
description:
🌞💦 Make a Splash This Summer with Our Inflatable Swimming Pool! 💦🌞
From backyard fun to beat-the-heat moments, this is every kid’s ultimate summer dream! 🏖️👶🧒Introducing the Kids Republic Inflatable Swimming Pool – perfect for safe, splashy fun right at home!

🔹 Soft, Durable & Safe Material
🔹 Easy to Inflate & Deflate
🔹 Spacious Enough for Siblings or Friends
🔹 Perfect for Outdoor & Indoor Use
🔹 Bright Colors to Spark Joy & Excitement

👶 Ideal for Toddlers & Young Kids – Fun and safe water play guaranteed!

🎁 A perfect addition to your summer essentials or a fun birthday surprise! ☀️🎉

💙 Let the summer memories begin – one splash at a time! 💙
Size: 115 x 82 x 33 cm
